actorPermissionLevel$comment: Was FULL_PERMISSIONS, which set isWhiteListedForAgenticPayments=false and lowers the quality score. main.py uses only the default dataset, Actor.charge and the status message, all allowed under limited permissions. No rebuild needed for this switch.
defaultRunOptions$comment: Measured 2026-09-11 on the same 8 emails: 4 GB 32.5 s / 0.0362 CU, 2 GB 34.7 s / 0.0193 CU, 1 GB 52.8 s / 0.0147 CU; peak RSS 150-210 MB. 2 GB halves compute at the same speed; 1 GB is 62% slower. August compute cost was $65.79 on $194 developer revenue, so this is worth about $30/month at that volume.
